sentences.en: Which trinket do you want to buy? This one looks pretty!
sentences.zh: 你想买哪个小装饰品？这个挺好看的！

sentences.en: The quaint little antique shop is full of unique trinkets, knick-knacks, and curios.
sentences.zh: 这家古色古香的小古董店里面摆满了各种独特的装饰品、小玩意和奇珍异宝。

sentences.en: She makes trinkets out of plexiglass.
sentences.zh: 她用有机玻璃制作小饰品。

senses.zh: 小装饰品；不值钱的小玩意儿
